baseline.meaning: Previously accepted bounded 3.1 C21 regression; not independent-witness or family acceptance.

scopeDecision.decision: Retain MQTT5 and reduced Kafka as explicit revision-one exclusions; complete all required HTTP/HTTPS, WS/WSS and MQTT311/MQTTS cells across three siblings.

scopeDecision.reopen: Separate authority-complete package with finite correspondence and independent evidence.

entries.title: Revision-one mqtt5 exclusion

authority.clause: §14 MQTT 5 (conditional)

entries.acceptanceCriterion: Reviewed refusal and coverage evidence closes the profile disposition without inventing driver semantics.
findings: Exclusion decision recorded; normative sibling propagation and frozen review remain required.

exclusion.rationale: Retain existing non-admission: MQTT5 needs a separate version-specific session/reason-code/property correspondence; revision one completes the required MQTT311 contract.
exclusion.propagation: Do not interpret native binding fields; exclude affected cell only and preserve unrelated represented cells.
exclusion.observable: Pre-dispatch refusal, zero wire traffic and exhaustive excluded-cell coverage with no emitted binding.
exclusion.reopen: Pinned complete clean-start/session-expiry, reason-code, property and packet/lifecycle rules; D/P/S and independent real-peer evidence.
